protocol.gene_axis: 17,555-symbol intersection of Arc gene_names / scGPT vocab / Geneformer V1 tokens

scgpt.binning: per-cell quantile bins 1..51 for nonzero values, zero -> 0
scgpt.sequence: deterministic top-1200 genes by log-normalized value; no CLS token
scgpt.pooling: avg-pool over non-pad tokens (checkpoint trained with no_cls=True)
scgpt.attention: checkpoint trained with fast_transformer=True (Wqkv layout); loaded on CPU via _PureTorchFlashMHA, an exact-parameter-name stand-in using torch.nn.Linear + scaled_dot_product_attention. The compiled flash-attn package is NOT used.
scgpt.checkpoint_load_disclosure: 10 cls_decoder tensors are absent and randomly initialised but never called; flag_encoder.weight is unused; all 144 transformer tensors and the encoder/decoder weights load exactly
scgpt.delta: value(target)=0 on the FIXED sequence; mlm_output(pert) - mlm_output(base); cell-mean; scatter to gene axis

geneformer.sequence: rank-descending within cell, top-2048 Ensembl tokens, pad -> 0
geneformer.pooling: mean of last hidden state over non-pad tokens
geneformer.delta: target token -> <mask>(1); cell-embedding shift (cell-mean) projected onto the model's gene-token embedding matrix

protocol.delta_scale_warning: Neither adapter delta is on a log2FC scale and the two are not on a common scale with each other or with the CRISPRi ground truth. DES/PDS are scale-free; MAE requires per-perturbation z-scoring and must be labelled as such.
protocol.preregistration_note: Implements the preregistered ModelAdapter interface (embed, predict_delta) for the two frozen models. No hypothesis, metric, fold, seed, dataset inclusion rule or falsification threshold is changed. The concrete tokenization/pooling/delta construction are implementation details of the adapter and are disclosed here; whether a timestamped registration amendment is required is a decision for the author/editor, not for this code.
